prompt:
/ccdi-federation-ai-copilot

Using the CCDI Federation API, fetch live metadata and report how many unique subjects diagnosed with neuroblastoma exist in each federation node. Summarize per-node counts and note any nodes that returned errors instead of data.
expectedOutput: Per-node neuroblastoma counts; PCDC and ccdi-ecDNA errors reported; uses /subject-diagnosis. Baseline per-node counts (±5%): CCDI-DCC ~3999, KidsFirst ~537, StJude ~275, Treehouse ~198, ccdi-iusccc-pst ~12. Must explicitly report errors for PCDC, ccdi-ecDNA — not as zero counts.
